verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of built-in object storage (an S3-style bucket service) for persisting user uploads. The only storage evidence is Fly Volumes, managed through the Machines API, and a generic marketing mention of "storage." Volumes are machine-attached disk, an adjacent capability rather than object storage, so they earn no credit; community users also report having no S3 replacement and leaving Fly to store user assets.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage

citations.quote: The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.
Host the web apps you and your agents build, with Postgres and storage.
